newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian gas producers welcome tax deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian gas producers welcome tax deal.

text.p: The Australian Petroleum Production and Exploration Association (APPEA) said on Thursday the resolution of a dispute over the Victorian petroleum resource rent tax clears the way for major gas industry reform.

"The Victorian Premier's (Jeff Kennett) assurance that the settlement clears the way for major reform of the gas industry, including greater incentive for new exploration, is most welcome," acting executive director Peter Cochrane said.
The Victorian state government said on Wednesday it had reached a A$1.0 billion settlement with Bass Strait gas producers, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd and Exxon Corp, over the tax.
At issue was whether BHP and Exxon subsidiary Esso had the right to pass on the tax under their existing contracts with Victorian government-owned entities GasCor and Generation Victoria.
Cochrane said the resolution must spur all state and territory governments to resolve the major outstanding issues on the gas reform agenda.
The Australian government said on Wednesday the resolution would pave the way for increased competition in the gas market.
